title: Ya-Sin 36:29-32 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 19 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ya-Sin 36:29-32 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 19. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ خَٰمِدُونَ (٢٩) يَٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ (٣٠)
أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ (٣١) وَإِن كُلٌّۭ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ (٣٢)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.
How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.
Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?
And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Tanween before و: idgham with ghunnah
Idgham without ghunnah: tanween into ل

questions.q: Chunk and link Ya-Sin 36:29-32 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 36:29-32 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 36:29-32 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Find two waqf signs in 36:29 to 32 and say what each means.
questions.a: ۚ in 36:30 after ٱلْعِبَادِ: stopping and continuing are both allowed.

questions.q: Link 36:31 to the history we study: how many nations were destroyed for mocking?
questions.a: Many generations (al-qurun); the Qur'an names 'Aad, Thamud, Pharaoh's people and others.

options: One shout, and they were extinguished
questions.a: A) One shout, and they were extinguished. 36:29: 'It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.'

questions.q: Think again: 'How regretful for the servants' (36:30): every messenger was mocked. Why do people mock what they do not understand?
questions.a: Pride, fear of change, following the crowd; mocking is easier than thinking.
